item.title: Patch: Critical Fortinet Vulnerabilities Allow Code Execution and Routing Manipulation
item.description:
Fortinet Critical Fortinet: fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Fortinet Critical Fortinet. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available

item.title: Keep patched: Fortinet FortiMail: Path Traversal
item.description:
Fortinet FortiMail: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 7.4.9, 7.6.7, 8.0.2

First step: Update Fortinet FortiMail to the fixed version for your release line (for example 7.4.9, 7.6.7 or 8.0.2).

Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-104286
